The Land Development Agency presents Woodbrook, a new residential development located in Shankill, Dublin 18. One-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments are available to rent from €1,495 per calendar month.

Located on South Dublin’s scenic coast, Woodbrook combines coastal charm with convenient transport links. The new Woodbrook DART station is a short walk away, with journeys to Dublin city centre taking approximately 45 minutes. Regular bus services connect the area with Dún Laoghaire, Cherrywood and Bray, while the M11, N11 and M50 are also easily accessible.

Residents can enjoy a wide range of outdoor amenities nearby. Shanganagh Park offers scenic walkways and a playground, while Shanganagh Bay Beach provides picturesque coastal views. Woodbrook Golf Club is a short stroll away from the development. Shankill village and Bray offer a wide range of restaurants, cafés, shops, and other local amenities.

Woodbrook is also conveniently located close to primary and secondary schools, such as Woodbrook College, St. Peter’s Primary School, and Ravenswell Primary School.
